name: Chandra's Ignition
oracle_text: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to each other creature and each opponent.
blocked_sentences: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to each other creature and each opponent.

needs.what: a way for the `damage` op to attribute the damage to an object other than the resolving spell/ability -- here, the targeted creature -- so that the target's own deathtouch, lifelink, wither and infect apply to every point dealt, and so damage-source-based replacement/prevention effects see the creature rather than the sorcery
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `damage` in `ops` deals damage from the resolving source; nothing in the packet's vocabulary names a substitute source object, and `snapshot` only captures a value (it would let `power_of` be read, not reassign who deals the hit). Approximating with plain `damage` would make Chandra's Ignition mis-handle the common lifelink/deathtouch case it is played for.

needs.what: a selector key that excludes the effect's chosen target from a mass selection -- 'each OTHER creature' -- i.e. the complement of the object bound by `target` within an `objects` filter
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `selector_keys` has `exclude_self`, which excludes the ability's own source (the sorcery), not the targeted creature, and `target` selects that creature rather than excluding it. There is no `not_target`/`exclude_target` key, so any expressible form would damage all creatures including the source creature -- a different card.
